title: Llama 2 Public Availability
summary: Meta announced the availability of Llama 2 on July 18, 2023, making the next-generation model family available free of charge for research and commercial use and providing model weights and starting code for pretrained and conversational fine-tuned versions.
significance: A dated public-availability milestone for Llama 2, distinct from the February 2023 gated research release of the first LLaMA model family.

verification.note: Meta's first-party announcement is dated July 18, 2023 and explicitly announces Llama 2 availability, free research and commercial use, and provision of model weights and starting code. The Llama 2 technical paper was submitted to arXiv on the same date and describes release of pretrained and fine-tuned models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters. This candidate records the dated public-availability milestone only; it does not infer development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, or relationship edges.
